sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“罪案档案呈现”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Warnings, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 温馨提示，本集节目说明可在您的应用程式或我们的网站上查看。

sentences.en: Dear Colin, I'm just going to sleep now.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的科林，我现在准备去睡觉了。

sentences.en: For how long, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 至于要睡多久，我也不知道。

sentences.en: Thank you for your help over the past few days, and for the good times in our marriage.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你这几天对我的帮助，也谢谢你带给我我们婚姻中的美好时光。

sentences.en: I don't know what to say to you because I don't know how I feel, but I have seen that life goes on after a few weeks of pain.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该对你说什么，因为我不知道自己现在的感受，但我已经看到，在经历了几个星期的痛苦之后，生活还要继续。

sentences.en: And, let's face it Colin, I am nothing in comparison to what you lost in the one you loved a while back.
sentences.zh: 而且，咱们面对现实吧，科林，比起你前不久失去的挚爱，我根本算不上什么。

sentences.en: If I wake up in the morning, just let this be our secret.
sentences.zh: 如果我早上醒来，就让这成为我们俩的秘密吧。

sentences.en: Leslie, on the morning of Sunday May 19, 1991, in the Northern Irish town of Coleraine,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利，1991年5月19日星期日清晨，在北爱尔兰的科尔雷恩小镇，

sentences.en: Jim Flanagan received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·弗拉纳根接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: On the other line was Colin Howell, a good friend and fellow parishioner at the Coleraine Baptist Church, where Jim was an elder.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是科林·豪威尔，他是科尔雷恩浸信会教堂的好友兼同道会众，吉姆是那里的长老。

sentences.en: Colin was worried about his wife, 31-year-old Leslie.
sentences.zh: 科林很担心他31岁的妻子莱斯利。

sentences.en: According to Colin, Leslie had left abruptly during the night and hadn't been in contact since.
sentences.zh: 据科林所说，莱斯利在夜里突然离家，之后便一直联系不上。

sentences.en: He suspected where she was, but couldn't check himself as he was at home with their four children,
sentences.zh: 他大概猜到她在哪里，但自己走不开，因为他得在家照顾四个孩子，

sentences.en: ranging in age from a few months old to six, and had no one else to look after them.
sentences.zh: 他们的年龄从几个月到六岁不等，而且没有其他人可以帮忙照看。

sentences.en: Colin believed Leslie might have gone to the home of her recently deceased father in the small coastal village of Castle Rock, about a 15-minute drive from Coleraine.
sentences.zh: 科林认为莱斯利可能去了她不久前去世的父亲位于卡斯尔罗克的家中，那是一个小海滨村庄，从科尔雷恩开车大约15分钟车程。

sentences.en: The loss had affected Leslie deeply, and she had been struggling emotionally as a result.
sentences.zh: 丧父之痛对莱斯利打击很大，因此她一直在情感上苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: As a church elder who provided personal support to members of the congregation,
sentences.zh: 作为一名为会众提供个人支持的教会长老，

sentences.en: Jim Flanagan agreed to visit the Castle Rock residence to look for Leslie.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·弗拉纳根答应去卡斯尔罗克的住宅找找莱斯利。

sentences.en: When he arrived, he walked around to the outside of the property, but it didn't appear that anyone else was there.
sentences.zh: 他到达后，绕着房子的外围走了一圈，但看起来里面并没有其他人。

sentences.en: He looked through a window into the garage and spotted a Renault Savannah hatchback reverse-parked inside.
sentences.zh: 他透过窗户向车库里望去，发现一辆雷诺萨凡纳两厢车倒车停在里面。

sentences.en: The car belonged to the Howell family, but Leslie was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 这辆车是豪威尔一家的，但不见莱斯利的踪影。

sentences.en: Jim went to see Colin Howell in person to report his findings.
sentences.zh: 吉姆亲自去找科林·豪威尔汇报他的发现。

sentences.en: Colin was growing increasingly anxious about the situation.
sentences.zh: 科林对目前的状况感到越来越焦虑。

sentences.en: He revealed that Leslie had been drinking the night before, and that he had contacted local police stations and hospitals to see if she might have been involved in an accident.
sentences.zh: 他透露，莱斯利前一天晚上喝了酒，他已经联系了当地的警察局和医院，想看看她是否遇到了意外。

sentences.en: Nothing had been reported.
sentences.zh: 没有任何相关的报告。

sentences.en: Now the family's Renault was found at Castle Rock, yet Leslie was still missing.
sentences.zh: 现在家里的雷诺车在卡斯尔罗克被找到了，可莱斯利依然下落不明。

sentences.en: Colin suspected that she might be with a man named Trevor Buchanan.
sentences.zh: 科林怀疑她可能和一个叫特雷弗·布坎南的男人在一起。

sentences.en: Jim knew Trevor well.
sentences.zh: 吉姆对特雷弗很熟悉。

sentences.en: He was a 32-year-old police officer who resided in Coleraine with his wife and two young children.
sentences.zh: 他是一名32岁的警官，和妻子及两个幼子住在科尔雷恩。

sentences.en: Not only was he a long-time member of the Baptist Church, but Colin had also previously confided in Jim that Leslie had been having an affair with Trevor for some time.
sentences.zh: 他不仅是浸信会的长期成员，而且科林以前也曾向吉姆吐露过，称莱斯利一段时间以来一直与特雷弗保持着婚外情。

sentences.en: Jim was expected at a church service that morning.
sentences.zh: 吉姆那天早上还要去参加教会礼拜。

sentences.en: Before he left the Howell home, Colin showed him a message written on a crumpled piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 在他离开豪威尔家之前，科林给他看了一条写在一张揉皱的纸上的信息。

sentences.en: Leslie was a prolific writer who enjoyed penning letters to friends and family.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利是个多产的写作者，喜欢给朋友和家人写信。

sentences.en: The letter was clearly written by her, but her normally small and neat handwriting was messier than usual.
sentences.zh: 这封信显然是她写的，但她平时小巧整洁的字迹比平时更显凌乱。

sentences.en: Addressed to Colin, it spoke of Leslie's intention to go to sleep for an undetermined amount of time.
sentences.zh: 信是写给科林的，里面谈到莱斯利打算睡上一段时间未定的觉。

sentences.en: She thanked her husband for his help recently and for the good times that they had shared during their marriage.
sentences.zh: 她感谢丈夫最近对她的帮助，以及他们在婚姻中共享的美好时光。

sentences.en: She assured him that, after a few weeks of pain, his life would go on.
sentences.zh: 她向他保证，经历了几周的痛苦之后，他的生活会继续下去。

sentences.en: The letter ended.
sentences.zh: 信到此结束。

sentences.en: If I wake up in the morning, just let this be our secret.
sentences.zh: 如果我早上醒来，就让这成为我们俩的秘密吧。

sentences.en: To Jim Flanagan, the letter came across as a kind of farewell.
sentences.zh: 在吉姆·弗拉纳根看来，这封信读起来就像是一种告别。

sentences.en: However, he didn't feel qualified enough to say for certain that it was a suicide note.
sentences.zh: 然而，他觉得自己不够资格断定这就是一封遗书。

sentences.en: After Jim left for church, Colin Howell called another friend from the parish, Derek McCauley, and asked him to come over.
sentences.zh: 吉姆去教堂后，科林·豪威尔给教区的另一位朋友德里克·麦考利打了电话，请他过来一趟。

sentences.en: While speaking with Derek, Colin revealed more details about the night before.
sentences.zh: 在与德里克交谈时，科林透露了更多关于前一晚的细节。

sentences.en: He admitted that Trevor Buchanan had come to the Howell home and they had gotten into a physical altercation.
sentences.zh: 他承认特雷弗·布坎南曾来到豪威尔家，两人发生过肢体冲突。

sentences.en: It appeared to have been brief and not particularly violent, as Derek didn't notice any visible scratches,
sentences.zh: 这似乎很短暂，而且算不上特别暴力，因为德里克没有注意到科林身上有任何明显的抓痕、

sentences.en: bruises or blood on Colin that would suggest a serious fight had taken place.
sentences.zh: 淤青或血迹来表明发生过严重的打斗。

sentences.en: Though, he did have a bump on his head.
sentences.zh: 不过，他的头确实鼓了个包。

sentences.en: Colin said that, after the fight, Trevor had left the house with Leslie.
sentences.zh: 科林说，冲突过后，特雷弗带着莱斯利离开了房子。

sentences.en: She had taken the keys to her father's house in Castle Rock, which was why Colin suspected that was where she had gone.
sentences.zh: 她拿走了她父亲在卡斯尔罗克房子的钥匙，这就是为什么科林怀疑她去了那里。

sentences.en: Colin also showed Derek the letter Leslie had written to him, although Derek didn't pay much attention to it.
sentences.zh: 科林还给德里克看了莱斯利写给他的信，不过德里克并没有太在意。

sentences.en: Despite having already sent Jim Flanagan without result, Colin asked that Derek McCauley to check the Castle Rock house for Leslie.
sentences.zh: 尽管已经派吉姆·弗拉纳根去过却没有结果，科林还是要求德里克·麦考利去卡斯尔罗克的房子查看莱斯利的情况。

sentences.en: Derek was uncomfortable with the requeSt.
sentences.zh: 德里克对这个请求感到很不自在。

sentences.en: He was aware that Trevor Buchanan was a police officer involved in an extramarital affair with Leslie.
sentences.zh: 他知道特雷弗·布坎南是一名与莱斯利有婚外情的警官。

sentences.en: Tensions were running high, as Trevor had apparently been involved in a physical altercation with Colin hours earlier.
sentences.zh: 由于特雷弗显然在几小时前与科林发生过肢体冲突，双方气氛分外紧张。

sentences.en: Derek was concerned that if he arrived unannounced at the Castle Rock house, Trevor, who could be carrying his service pistol, might shoot him.
sentences.zh: 德里克担心，如果自己不请自来到卡斯尔罗克的房子，随身可能带着公务配枪的特雷弗会向他开枪。

sentences.en: Despite his concerns, Derek eventually agreed to make the visit.
sentences.zh: 尽管有所顾虑，德里克最终还是同意去探访一番。

sentences.en: When he arrived, he checked the front door and found it closed but unlocked.
sentences.zh: 他到达后，检查了前门，发现门关着但没有反锁。

sentences.en: Derek pushed the door open and called out, making a point to identify himself to ensure Trevor didn't mistake him for Colin Howell.
sentences.zh: 德里克推开门大声呼喊，特意自报家门，以免特雷弗把他错认成科林·豪威尔。

sentences.en: He added,
sentences.zh: 他又补充道：

sentences.en: Trevor, you know the drama is over now.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗，你知道闹剧现在已经结束了。

sentences.en: There was no response.
sentences.zh: 没有任何回应。

sentences.en: Derek entered the house and began checking each room cautiously, fearing that Trevor might be lying in wait somewhere.
sentences.zh: 德里克走进屋里，开始小心翼翼地检查每一个房间，担心特雷弗可能会藏在某处伺机而动。

sentences.en: After finding the house empty and otherwise normal, he went out to check the garage.
sentences.zh: 在发现屋里空无一人且一切如常后，他走到外面去检查车库。

sentences.en: Through the window, Derek saw the Howell's Renault parked inside.
sentences.zh: 透过窗户，德里克看到豪威尔家的雷诺车停在里面。

sentences.en: It looked unusually dirty.
sentences.zh: 它看起来异常肮脏。

sentences.en: There didn't appear to be anyone in or around the vehicle, but Derek thought he could smell gas.
sentences.zh: 车内或车子周围似乎没有人，但德里克觉得能闻到一股煤气味。

sentences.en: He left to speak with Colin Howell, who was shocked to learn that Derek hadn't found Leslie or Trevor at Castle Rock either, repeatedly exclaiming, exclaiming, they were there.
sentences.zh: 他离开并去找科林·豪威尔，科林得知德里克也没有在卡斯尔罗克找到莱斯利或特雷弗时感到十分震惊，连连惊呼他们就在那里。

sentences.en: The only thing Derek could report on was the smell of gas he thought he had noticed around the garage.
sentences.zh: 德里克唯一能报告的，就是他似乎在车库周围闻到的煤气味。

sentences.en: Colin reached out to church elder Jim Flanagan once again, asking him to return to Castle Rock for a second time to conduct a third search.
sentences.zh: 科林再次联系了教会长老吉姆·弗拉纳根，请他第二次返回卡斯尔罗克进行第三次搜查。

sentences.en: Jim agreed.
sentences.zh: 吉姆答应了。

sentences.en: After church, he left with another parishioner, who happened to be an off-duty police detective.
sentences.zh: 礼拜结束后，他与另一位恰好是休班警探的会众一同出发了。

sentences.en: The two men knocked on the front door and several windows, but nothing stirred within.
sentences.zh: 两人敲了前门和几扇窗户，但里面毫无动静。

sentences.en: They found a back door leading into the kitchen wide open, with a ceiling light on inside.
sentences.zh: 他们发现通往厨房的后门大开着，里面的天花板灯还亮着。

sentences.en: They entered and examined each room, but there was still no sign of Leslie or Trevor.
sentences.zh: 他们走进去检查了每个房间，但依然没有莱斯利或特雷弗的踪迹。

sentences.en: Jim then headed out to the garage to check it again.
sentences.zh: 于是吉姆走向车库再次进行检查。

sentences.en: This time, he lifted the roller door open.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他把卷帘门推开了。

sentences.en: An overwhelming odour of exhaust fumes escaped, along with a small amount of smoke.
sentences.zh: 一股刺鼻的尾气味扑面而来，还伴随着少量的烟雾。

sentences.en: The Renault's engine was no longer running, but Jim noticed a garden hose attached to the exhaust pipe led into the car.
sentences.zh: 雷诺车的发动机已经熄火了，但吉姆注意到一根连接着排气管的园艺软管通进了车内。

sentences.en: Inside the vehicle, he discovered Trevor Buchanan's body slumped low in the driver's seat, with one of his legs caught in the door.
sentences.zh: 在车里，他发现特雷弗·布坎南的尸体低低地瘫在驾驶座上，一条腿卡在车门上。

sentences.en: Jim called out to his companion and continued examining the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 吉姆大声招呼同伴，并继续检查车内。

sentences.en: He soon spotted Leslie Howell's body through a window into the back.
sentences.zh: 很快，他透过后车窗看到了莱斯利·豪威尔的尸体。

sentences.en: She was wearing a headset of her handheld cassette player with family photographs laid out beside her.
sentences.zh: 她戴着手持盒式磁带播放器的耳机，身旁摆放着全家福照片。

sentences.en: Neither Trevor nor Leslie had a pulse.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗和莱斯利都已经没有了脉搏。

sentences.en: Autopsies confirmed that the pair had died from carbon monoxide poisoning.
sentences.zh: 尸检证实两人死于一氧化碳中毒。

sentences.en: The findings were consistent with the scene at Castle Rock.
sentences.zh: 这一调查结果与卡斯尔罗克的现场情况相吻合。

sentences.en: It appeared Trevor had driven Leslie to the house and parked the Renault inside the garage.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况似乎是特雷弗开车送莱斯利来到这栋房子，并将雷诺车停在了车库里。

sentences.en: The hose was then attached to the car's exhaust pipe, with the other end fed into the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 接着，一根软管连接到了汽车的排气管上，另一端则通进了车内。

sentences.en: The pair then remained inside the running vehicle with the garage door closed, allowing carbon monoxide to accumulate until they lost consciousness and died.
sentences.zh: 随后，两人呆在发动着的汽车里，车库门紧闭，任由一氧化碳积聚，直到他们失去意识并死亡。

sentences.en: Leslie and Trevor appeared otherwise normal and healthy, with no signs of violence or other suspicious injuries.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利和特雷弗表面上看起来都很正常且健康，没有遭受暴力或其他可疑伤害的迹象。

sentences.en: Trevor had no alcohol in his system, while Leslie had a small amount.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗体内没有酒精，而莱斯利体内含有少量的酒精。

sentences.en: Further tests carried out on Leslie revealed the presence of three different types of prescription sedatives, commonly used to treat depression and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 对莱斯利进行的进一步检测显示，她体内存在三种不同类型的处方镇静剂，这些药物通常用于治疗抑郁症和焦虑症。

sentences.en: All three drugs were present at levels considered to be within the therapeutic range.
sentences.zh: 这三种药物的含量都在被认为属于治疗剂量的范围内。

sentences.en: Based on these findings, the pathologist concluded that neither the alcohol nor the sedatives had contributed to Leslie's death.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现，病理学家得出结论，酒精和镇静剂均未导致莱斯利的死亡。

sentences.en: Given there were no signs of foul play, it appeared that both deaths were the result of some sort of suicide pact.
sentences.zh: 既然没有他杀迹象，这两起死亡似乎都是某种自杀协议的结果。

sentences.en: Investigators were left to determine what could have driven Leslie and Trevor to such desperate lengths.
sentences.zh: 调查人员只能去确定究竟是什么促使莱斯利和特雷弗走上了如此绝望的绝路。

sentences.en: Leslie and Trevor were a part of the same close-knit social circle within their shared church congregation.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利和特雷弗属于他们共同的教会会众中那个紧密相连的社交圈子的一部分。

sentences.en: Many within had heard rumours of their affair, and there were reports that church leaders had attempted to intervene.
sentences.zh: 圈内许多人都听过他们有染的传闻，据报道教会领导曾试图进行干预。

sentences.en: Within Baptist teaching, adultery is regarded as a serious violation of the sacred covenant of marriage and a major sin against one's spiritual commitment to Christ and the church.
sentences.zh: 在浸信会的教义中，通奸被视为对神圣婚姻誓约的严重违背，也是对一个人对基督和教会属灵承诺的重大罪孽。

sentences.en: While counselling, discipline and forgiveness might be offered to those who repent,
sentences.zh: 虽然可能会向那些忏悔的人提供辅导、管教和宽恕，

sentences.en: Leslie and Trevor's affair seemingly persisted.
sentences.zh: 但莱斯利和特雷弗的婚外情似乎仍在继续。

sentences.en: Some believed that the decision to take their lives together was driven by feelings of humiliation and shame.
sentences.zh: 一些人认为，他们共同寻短见的决定是出于羞辱和耻辱感。

sentences.en: Perhaps, as word of their sins spread, they feared they would be rejected by their faith-based community.
sentences.zh: 也许，随着他们罪过的事情传开，他们害怕被自己的信仰社区所唾弃。

sentences.en: Whatever the reason, the act was nevertheless shocking, especially for Trevor Buchanan's friends and family.
sentences.zh: 无论出于什么原因，这一行为依然令人震惊，特别是对特雷弗·布坎南的朋友和家人而言。

sentences.en: Because he hadn't left a note or any other form of farewell, they were left to wonder whether there had been warning signs that they had failed to recognise.
sentences.zh: 由于他没有留下字条或任何其他形式的告别，他们只能去琢磨是否曾经出现过他们未能识别的危险信号。

sentences.en: But, no matter how hard they tried to make sense of it, the circumstances didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 但是，无论他们如何努力去理解，这些情况都讲不通。

sentences.en: There had been nothing obvious in Trevor's demeanour, words or behaviour in the weeks before his death to suggest that he was suicidal,
sentences.zh: 在特雷弗死前的几周里，他的神情、言语或行为中并没有任何明显的迹象表明他有自杀倾向，

sentences.en: and he had generally been regarded as mentally stable.
sentences.zh: 而且他通常被认为精神状态很稳定。

sentences.en: By all accounts, he loved his wife, children, parents, siblings and job, making it difficult for those who knew him to reconcile that he would willingly leave them all behind.
sentences.zh: 根据各方说法，他深爱着他的妻子、孩子、父母、兄弟姐妹和工作，这使得认识他的人很难接受他会甘心抛下这一切。

sentences.en: As a deeply religious man who was heavily involved in his church, it was also hard to imagine that Trevor would choose to take his life,
sentences.zh: 作为一个深笃宗教且深度参与教会事务的虔诚之人，也很难想象特雷弗会选择结束自己的生命，

sentences.en: particularly within a faith that viewed suicide as an act contrary to God's commandments.
sentences.zh: 特别是在一个将自杀视为违背上帝诫命的行为的信仰中。

sentences.en: At the same time, Baptist teaching held that suicide wasn't an unpardonable sin and didn't automatically condemn a believer to hell.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，浸信会的教义认为自杀并非不可饶恕之罪，也不会自动将信徒判入地狱。

sentences.en: Maybe, Trevor's loved ones thought, this understanding offered him some measure of reassurance as he came to terms with his decision.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗的亲人们认为，这种理解也许在他接受自己的决定时提供了一定程度的安慰。

sentences.en: But their confusion was amplified by the scene itself.
sentences.zh: 但现场本身却加剧了他们的困惑。

sentences.en: It appeared that Trevor might have had second thoughts about dying.
sentences.zh: 情况表明，特雷弗可能对赴死产生了犹豫。

sentences.en: His right knee was found caught in the joint of the driver's side door, suggesting that he had attempted to escape the vehicle,
sentences.zh: 人们发现他的右膝卡在驾驶侧车门的铰链处，这表明他曾试图逃离汽车，

sentences.en: but was overcome by the toxic fumes before he could do so.
sentences.zh: 但在成功逃脱之前就被有毒气体熏倒了。

sentences.en: Stranger still, the driver's side window was left wide open, which seemed unusual given that it would have prevented the fumes from effectively filling the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 更奇怪的是，驾驶座一侧的车窗大开着，鉴于这会阻碍毒气充满整个车厢，此举显得很不寻常。

sentences.en: In contrast, Leslie Howell appeared to have been accepting of her fate.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，莱斯利·豪威尔似乎接受了自己的命运。

sentences.en: In addition to the shrine of personal mementos arranged around her and the gospel music she had been listening to,
sentences.zh: 除了她身边摆放的个人纪念品圣坛以及她一直在听的福音音乐外，

sentences.en: there were reports that she appeared to have a faint smile on her face after death.
sentences.zh: 据报道，死后她的脸上似乎还挂着淡淡的微笑。

sentences.en: This led some to wonder whether Leslie had coerced Trevor into dying with her, only for him to struggle to fully commit in the final moment.
sentences.zh: 这让一些人怀疑，是否是莱斯利胁迫特雷弗与她一起赴死，而特雷弗只是在最后关头才挣扎着想要彻底反悔。

sentences.en: Alternatively, she might have persuaded him to help her end her life, only for him to become trapped while attempting to get away.
sentences.zh: 或者，她可能说服了他来帮她结束生命，结果却在自己试图逃跑时被困住了。

sentences.en: The notion that Leslie had lost the will to live was not entirely unsurprising among her friends and family.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利失去求生欲的想法在她的亲友当中并不算太意外。

sentences.en: Many had noticed that the normally energetic and outgoing woman had become increasingly withdrawn and was struggling to cope in recent years.
sentences.zh: 许多人注意到，这位平日里精力充沛、性格外向的女性近年来变得越来越孤僻，且在艰难度日。

sentences.en: There were also circumstances that had, in the words of one friend, made carrying on with everyday life a tremendous effort for Leslie.
sentences.zh: 正如一位朋友所说，还有一些环境使得莱斯利觉得维持日常生活都需要付出巨大的努力。

sentences.en: Leslie first met Colin Howell at a church gathering.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利最初是在一次教会聚会上结识科林·豪威尔的。

sentences.en: Both had been raised as staunch Baptists, a denomination within the Protestant Christian tradition.
sentences.zh: 两人都是作为坚定的浸信会信徒抚养长大的，这是新教基督教传统中的一个教派。

sentences.en: Baptists regard the Bible as the ultimate and infallible guide for life,
sentences.zh: 浸信会将圣经视为生活的最高且无误的指南，

sentences.en: while salvation is understood as a free gift from God received through personal faith rather than earned through good works or religious rituals.
sentences.zh: 而救赎则被理解为上帝通过个人信仰给予的白白恩赐，而不是通过善行或宗教仪式挣得的。

sentences.en: Baptists to churches are generally autonomous, governing themselves through a congregational structure instead of a centralised hierarchy or system of bishops.
sentences.zh: 浸信会教堂通常是自治的，通过会众结构进行自我管理，而不是通过中央集权或主教制系统。

sentences.en: At the time, Leslie was training to become a nurse.
sentences.zh: 当时，莱斯利正在接受护士培训。

sentences.en: Described as attractive, warm-hearted and friendly, she was rarely short of something thoughtful to say and was the kind of person everyone naturally liked.
sentences.zh: 她被描述为一个具有吸引力、热心肠且友好的人，从不缺少体贴的话语，是那种每个人都会自然而然喜欢的人。

sentences.en: She also attracted plenty of male attention.
sentences.zh: 她也吸引了大量的男性目光。

sentences.en: So, when she accepted Colin's invitation to a formal at the university where he was studying dentistry, he was thrilled.
sentences.zh: 因此，当她接受科林的邀请，去参加他正在攻读牙医专业的大学举办的正式舞会时，他激动万分。

sentences.en: It marked the pair's first official date.
sentences.zh: 这标志着两人第一次正式约会。

sentences.en: They soon travelled overseas together, a holiday that strengthened their feelings for one another.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他们一起出国旅行，这次假期加深了彼此的感情。

sentences.en: They married in July 1983.
sentences.zh: 他们在1983年7月结婚。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Colin's career in dentistry flourished.
sentences.zh: 此后，科林的牙科事业蒸蒸日上。

sentences.en: A clinic he worked for in Coleraine eventually became one of the largest in Northern Ireland, with around 35,000 patients on its books.
sentences.zh: 他在科尔雷恩工作的一家诊所最终发展成为北爱尔兰最大的诊所之一，拥有大约35000名患者登记在册。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, he impressed the elders at the Coleraine Baptist Church, where his confidence, energy and commitment earned him an appointment as a leader of the Youth Fellowship.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他给科尔雷恩浸信会教堂的长老们留下了深刻印象，他的自信、活力和奉献精神使他被任命为青年团契的领袖。

sentences.en: The church and its community became a significant part of both Colin and Leslie's lives.
sentences.zh: 教堂及其社区成为了科林和莱斯利生活中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: While the Howell marriage began happily, things took a turn for Leslie once she became a mother.
sentences.zh: 虽然豪威尔夫妇的婚姻开始时很幸福，但自从莱斯利成为母亲后，情况就发生了变化。

sentences.en: Colin and Leslie's first child was born in October 1984, prompting Leslie to put her career on hold so she could remain at home to care for their baby.
sentences.zh: 科林和莱斯利的第一个孩子于1984年10月出生，这促使莱斯利暂停了她的职业生涯，以便能留在家里照顾他们的宝宝。

sentences.en: Compared with the demanding but rewarding work she had known as a nurse, she found domestic life boring, lonely and unsatisfying.
sentences.zh: 与她以前作为护士时那种既有要求又有回报的工作相比，她发现家庭生活枯燥、孤独且令人不满。

sentences.en: Colin offered her little understanding.
sentences.zh: 科林对她缺乏理解。

sentences.en: He was described as a single-minded misogynist who held very traditional views,
sentences.zh: 他被描述为一个思想顽固、有着极其传统观点的厌女者，

sentences.en: believing that a wife's place was in the home while it was his duty as a man to go out and provide for his family.
sentences.zh: 认为妻子的本分就在家里，而作为一个男人，出去赚钱养家是他的责任。

sentences.en: Unlike the compliant, orderly and dutiful women within their church, Leslie didn't conform to Colin's expectations of a wife.
sentences.zh: 与他们教会里那些顺从而又循规蹈矩的女性不同，莱斯利并不符合科林对妻子的期望。

sentences.en: He took issue with her failure to keep the house tidy, her poor management of the household finances,
sentences.zh: 他挑剔她没能把家里收拾干净，对家庭财务管理不善，

sentences.en: and the occasions when she left him to care for their baby so she could have time to herself.
sentences.zh: 以及有时把照顾婴儿的担子甩给他自己去享有私人时间。

sentences.en: Still, they were not the type to argue or fight, at least not in front of others.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们并不是那种会争吵的类型，至少不在别人面前这样。

sentences.en: In a letter to a friend, Leslie admitted,
sentences.zh: 在一封写给朋友的信中，莱斯利承认道：

sentences.en: I don't honestly think that I am a born housewife.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为我天生就不是个适合当家庭主妇的人。

sentences.en: Colin also grew irritated by Leslie's sarcasm, believing that she took pleasure in belittling him.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利的讽刺也让科林越来越恼火，他认为她以贬低他为乐。

sentences.en: These feelings were exacerbated by others, remarking that Leslie was too good for him.
sentences.zh: 当其他人评论说莱斯利配他绰绰有余时，这种情绪更加恶化了。

sentences.en: For her part, Leslie resented what she saw as Colin's arrogant and manipulative nature.
sentences.zh: 就莱斯利而言，她对科林那种傲慢且爱操纵的性格感到愤恨。

sentences.en: During Leslie's second pregnancy, her mother suffered a series of serious illnesses.
sentences.zh: 在莱斯利怀第二胎期间，她的母亲接连患上了一系列重病。

sentences.en: She died ten weeks before Leslie gave birth in November 1986.
sentences.zh: 就在莱斯利于1986年11月分娩前十周，她去世了。

sentences.en: In the aftermath, Leslie displayed symptoms consistent with postpartum depression, though she was never formally diagnosed by a professional.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，莱斯利表现出与产后抑郁相符的症状，尽管她从未获得专业人士的正式诊断。

sentences.en: Her third pregnancy occurred within an equally difficult and stressful period.
sentences.zh: 她的第三次怀孕发生在一段同样困难且充满压力的时期。

sentences.en: Colin had thrown himself into establishing his own dental clinic, a decision that reflected his tendency to act impulsively and without careful consideration of the risks.
sentences.zh: 科林全身心地投入到建立自己的牙科诊所中，这个决定反映出他做事冲动、对风险缺乏深思熟虑的倾向。

sentences.en: Colin self-admitted that he was never good at handling money, and he faced significant financial difficulties as he tried to get his clinic established.
sentences.zh: 科林自己承认他从来不擅长理财，在试图建立诊所时，他面临着重大的财务困难。

sentences.en: Despite this, he decided it was also the right time to purchase a larger and more expensive family home.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他还是决定这也是购买一套更大、更昂贵的家庭住宅的好时机。

sentences.en: Before long, the Howells had run out of money, and there was a very real fear that Colin would become bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，豪尔一家就花光了所有的钱，甚至产生了一种非常现实的担忧，那就是科林会破产。

sentences.en: Their new home was a fixer-upper, but money was so tight that they couldn't even afford to carpet the concrete floors.
sentences.zh: 他们的新家需要大肆装修，但资金如此紧缺，以至于他们连给水泥地面铺地毯的钱都拿不出来。

sentences.en: Their third child was born in May 1989.
sentences.zh: 他们的第三个孩子于1989年5月出生。

sentences.en: As the primary caregiver to three young children in an unfinished, poorly equipped and unpleasant home, Leslie struggled to cope.
sentences.zh: 作为一个未完工、设施简陋且令人不快的家里三个年幼孩子的全职照顾者，莱斯利苦苦挣扎，难以应付。

sentences.en: The following month, Leslie discovered she was pregnant again, something she found difficult to accept.
sentences.zh: 第二个月，莱斯利发现自己再次怀孕，这让她觉得难以接受。

sentences.en: While there was no doubt that she loved all of her children,
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问她深爱着自己所有的孩子，

sentences.en: the prospect of raising another newborn at a time when she was struggling mentally and financially was difficult to look forward to.
sentences.zh: 但在她精神和经济都举步维艰的时候，迎来另一个新生儿的前景让人实在高兴不起来。

sentences.en: She was at a point where she couldn't even withdraw money from the bank to cover the family's daily expenses.
sentences.zh: 她甚至落魄到无法从银行取钱来支付家庭的日常开销。

sentences.en: Things were so dire that, behind her back, Colin had put their new home on the market and was looking for someone to take over his fledgling business.
sentences.zh: 情况如此糟糕，以至于科林背着她把新家挂牌出售，并一直在寻找接手他那刚起步的生意的人。

sentences.en: Leslie's distress was compounded when she discovered that, shortly after the birth of their third child, Colin had embarked on a month-long affair with an old university friend.
sentences.zh: 当莱斯利发现，在他们的第三个孩子出生后不久，科林就和一位大学老朋友开始了一段长达一个月的婚外情时，她的痛苦雪上加霜。

sentences.en: At least one person close to the couple was left with the impression that Leslie was contemplating ending her marriage then and there.
sentences.zh: 至少有一位与这对夫妇关系密切的人留下了这样的印象：莱斯利当时正考虑当场结束这段婚姻。

sentences.en: Colin was reluctant to consider divorce, given his religious convictions and standing within the church.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他的宗教信仰和在教会中的地位，科林很不愿考虑离婚。

sentences.en: He feared how their friends and fellow congregants might react.
sentences.zh: 他担心他们的朋友和教友会作何反应。

sentences.en: Within their church community, divorce was not viewed favourably, with forgiveness and reconciliation strongly encouraged instead.
sentences.zh: 在他们的教会社区里，离婚并不被看好，相反，人们强烈鼓励宽恕和和解。

sentences.en: While the Howells vowed to move past the betrayal, things were never quite the same between them.
sentences.zh: 尽管豪尔夫妇发誓要抛开这次背叛，但他们之间的关系再也回不到从前了。

sentences.en: Leslie was left heartbroken, while Colin appeared unburdened by any sense of shame or guilt.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利心碎不已，而科林似乎没有背负任何羞耻感或负罪感。

sentences.en: Not long afterwards, he embarked on another affair.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，他又开始了一段新的婚外情。

sentences.en: Hazel Buchanan worked as an assistant at the nursery school attended by one of Colin and Leslie Howell's children.
sentences.zh: 黑兹尔·布坎南是科林和莱斯利·豪尔的孩子所上的幼儿园的一名助理。

sentences.en: She was also a fellow member of the Coleraine Baptist Church and a patient at Colin's dental practice.
sentences.zh: 她也是科雷兰浸信会的成员以及科林牙科诊所的患者。

sentences.en: Hazel lived with her husband, Trevor, and their two young children.
sentences.zh: 黑兹尔与丈夫特雷弗以及他们的两个年幼孩子住在一起。

sentences.en: In many ways, Hazel was seen as the opposite of Leslie.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，黑兹尔被视为莱斯利的对立面。

sentences.en: She was described as sheltered, shy, impressionable and lacking in confidence.
sentences.zh: 她被描述为受保护过度、害羞、易受影响且缺乏自信。

sentences.en: She was also considered a dutiful wife and mother.
sentences.zh: 她也被认为是一个顺从的妻子和母亲。

sentences.en: In 1990, while Leslie was heavily pregnant with their third child, Colin and Hazel began an affair.
sentences.zh: 1990年，当莱斯利怀着他们的第三个孩子时，科林和黑兹尔开始了婚外情。

sentences.en: Hazel would later claim that she became romantically involved with Colin Howell because of the isolation she felt while living away from her family support network.
sentences.zh: 黑兹尔后来声称，她之所以与科林·豪尔发生浪漫关系，是因为她远离了家庭支持网络，感到孤立无援。

sentences.en: She had never felt settled in Coleraine and struggled to connect with the local community, partly because of her quiet nature and difficulty socialising.
sentences.zh: 她从未在科雷兰感到安心，且难以融入当地社区，部分原因在于她性格安静、不善社交。

sentences.en: She also said that her husband, Trevor, accompanied her on almost every outing, implying that he was controlling and possessive of her.
sentences.zh: 她还说，她的丈夫特雷弗几乎每次外出都陪着她，暗示他对她有着强烈的控制欲和占有欲。

sentences.en: But those who knew the couple described Trevor differently.
sentences.zh: 但那些了解这对夫妇的人对特雷弗的描述却截然不同。

sentences.en: They asserted that Hazel took the dominant role in their marriage and Trevor was firmly under her control.
sentences.zh: 他们断言，黑兹尔在婚姻中占据主导地位，而特雷弗则完全受她控制。

sentences.en: This was evident when Trevor went to a friend's house to offer comfort following the deaths of two colleagues.
sentences.zh: 当特雷弗去一个朋友家，为两名同事的离世表达慰问时，这一点显露无遗。

sentences.en: He had only just arrived when Hazel called and demanded that he return home.
sentences.zh: 他才刚到不久，黑兹尔就打电话命令他立刻回家。

sentences.en: Despite his friend's protests, Trevor did as his wife told him.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的朋友极力劝阻，特雷弗还是照着他妻子的话做了。

sentences.en: To others, Trevor adored Hazel.
sentences.zh: 但在其他人看来，特雷弗对黑兹尔爱慕有加。

sentences.en: From the day they married, he was a devoted husband, in awe of his wife and immensely proud of her.
sentences.zh: 从他们结婚的第一天起，他就是一个尽职的丈夫，对妻子既敬畏又无比自豪。

sentences.en: He doted on her and sought to give her everything she could want, including a beautiful home, expensive furnishings and holidays.
sentences.zh: 他对她百依百顺，想要给她所有她想要的东西，包括美丽的家、昂贵的家具和假期。

sentences.en: Yet, some felt that nothing Trevor did was ever enough for Hazel.
sentences.zh: 然而，有些人觉得特雷弗做的一切对黑兹尔来说都永远不够。

sentences.en: Her expensive tastes placed considerable strain on their finances.
sentences.zh: 她奢侈的品味给他们的财政状况带来了沉重的压力。

sentences.en: When money was tied, Trevor was forced to deny her things, which left her dissatisfied.
sentences.zh: 当资金紧张时，特雷弗被迫拒绝她的要求，这让她很不满意。

sentences.en: To those around them, Hazel's priorities centred on her own wants rather than the needs of her family.
sentences.zh: 在身边人看来，黑兹尔关心的重点是她自己的欲望，而不是家人的需求。

sentences.en: Hazel said it wasn't until she began working at the nursery school that she gained a greater sense of independence.
sentences.zh: 黑兹尔说，直到她开始在幼儿园工作，她才获得了更大的独立感。

sentences.en: She began forming friendships with other young mothers, including Leslie Howell.
sentences.zh: 她开始与其他年轻母亲建立友谊，其中包括莱斯利·豪尔。

sentences.en: The experience helped build her confidence and gave her a stronger sense of identity outside the home.
sentences.zh: 这段经历帮助她树立了自信，并在家庭之外赋予了她更强烈的自我认同感。

sentences.en: As she became more independent, she said arguments with Trevor increased.
sentences.zh: 随着她变得更加独立，她说她与特雷弗的争吵也越来越多了。

sentences.en: She believed he resented the fact that she no longer depended on him as much.
sentences.zh: 她认为特雷弗对她不再那么依赖他这件事心存怨恨。

sentences.en: Their relationship became marked by poor communication and a lack of emotional closeness.
sentences.zh: 他们的关系开始呈现出沟通不良和缺乏情感亲密的特点。

sentences.en: To Hazel, Colin Howell's charming, passionate and intellectual personality was the opposite of Trevor's.
sentences.zh: 对黑兹尔来说，科林·豪尔迷人、充满激情且富有智慧的个性与特雷弗截然相反。

sentences.en: It was this contrast that drew her to him.
sentences.zh: 正是这种反差吸引她走向了他。

sentences.en: Colin and Hazel met privately on many occasions at the Buchanan Home, during church events, at Colin's Dental Clinic, in surrounding towns and even in the woods.
sentences.zh: 科林和黑兹尔在布坎南的家中、教会活动期间、科林的牙科诊所、周边城镇甚至树林里，私下里见过很多次面。

sentences.en: The pair were careful around others, taking precautions not to give the impression that anything suspicious was going on between them.
sentences.zh: 两人在别人面前非常小心，采取防范措施，以免给人留下他们之间有什么可疑事情发生的印象。

sentences.en: Almost everyone was convinced by their deception at first, except Trevor.
sentences.zh: 起初几乎所有人都被他们的伪装蒙蔽了，除了特雷弗。

sentences.en: He suspected something was amiss from the moment Colin began visiting his house under the guise of teaching Hazel to play the guitar.
sentences.zh: 从科林开始以教黑兹尔弹吉他为借口来他家串门的那一刻起，他就怀疑有什么不对劲。

sentences.en: While Trevor never witnessed anything untoward, others noticed that he appeared unusually anxious and agitated during this period.
sentences.zh: 虽然特雷弗从未亲眼目睹任何不轨行为，但其他人注意到他这段时间显得异常焦虑和烦躁。

sentences.en: One day, a church elder spotted Colin and Hazel meeting alone at the entrance of a forest park outside town.
sentences.zh: 一天，一位教会长老发现科林和黑兹尔独自在镇外的一处森林公园入口处会面。

sentences.en: Although he didn't see anything problematic, he was a close friend of Trevor Buchanan's and later confronted Colin about the meeting.
sentences.zh: 虽然他没有看到什么出格的事情，但他与特雷弗·布坎南是至交，后来就这次会面质问了科林。

sentences.en: Colin denied that he was having an affair, but suspicions were starting to grow.
sentences.zh: 科林否认自己有婚外情，但怀疑开始滋生。

sentences.en: Even Leslie, who had just given birth to their fourth child, sensed that her husband was becoming distant and was straying from their marriage again.
sentences.zh: 就连刚刚生下第四个孩子的莱斯利也感觉到，她的丈夫变得疏远了，并且再次偏离了他们的婚姻。

sentences.en: She noticed coins in his jogging trousers and deduced that he had been using a payphone to call someone while claiming to be out running.
sentences.zh: 她注意到他慢跑裤里的硬币，由此推断他声称外出跑步时，其实一直在用公用电话给某人打电话。

sentences.en: On another occasion, she overheard him speaking quietly on the telephone, arranging to meet a woman.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，她无意中听到他压低声音在电话里说话，安排与一个女人见面。

sentences.en: Colin planned a weekend away with a male friend, claiming that the strain in his marriage had prompted him to get out of the house.
sentences.zh: 科林计划和一个男性朋友去度周末，声称婚姻中的压力促使他想出门散散心。

sentences.en: Although his friend corroborated his account, Leslie couldn't shake the feeling that the trip never took place.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的朋友证实了他的说法，但莱斯利总觉得这趟旅行根本没有发生过。

sentences.en: She was right.
sentences.zh: 她猜对了。

sentences.en: Colin had spent the night with Hazel Buchanan.
sentences.zh: 科林是和黑兹尔·布坎南一起过夜的。

sentences.en: Leslie confided about her fears that her husband was being unfaithful to her pastor, John Hansford.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利向牧师约翰·汉斯福德吐露了她对丈夫不忠的恐惧。

sentences.en: Pastor John confronted Colin, but he continued to deny everything.
sentences.zh: 约翰牧师质问了科林，但科林继续矢口否认。

sentences.en: John then approached Hazel, who initially refused to admit the truth as well.
sentences.zh: 约翰随后找到了黑兹尔，起初她也拒绝承认真相。

sentences.en: Eventually, she tearfully confessed to the affair, though she gave the impression that it had only recently begun when it had been going on for some time.
sentences.zh: 最终，她泪流满面地坦白了这段婚外情，不过她给人的印象是这事才刚开始没多久，而实际上已经持续了一段时间。

sentences.en: Pastor John confronted Colin again, this time with Leslie present.
sentences.zh: 约翰牧师再次质问科林，这一次莱斯利也在场。

sentences.en: Realising that the truth was out, Colin was apologetic.
sentences.zh: 意识到真相已经败露，科林连声道歉。

sentences.en: He admitted that while his friendship with Hazel had been inappropriate, he maintained that they had never been sexually intimate.
sentences.zh: 他承认他与黑兹尔的友谊确实越界了，但他坚称他们从未有过肉体关系。

sentences.en: Pastor John then went to the Buchanan home and broke news of the affair to Trevor.
sentences.zh: 约翰牧师随后前往布坎南的家中，将婚外情的消息告诉了特雷弗。

sentences.en: He was visibly affected by his wife's betrayal, appearing tense and overwhelmed by embarrassment, humiliation and shame.
sentences.zh: 他受到了妻子背叛的沉重打击，显得紧张万分，被尴尬、羞辱和耻辱感压得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: As a result of their affair, Colin Howell was forced to resign from all of his church responsibilities, while Hazel Buchanan was no longer permitted to teach Sunday school.
sentences.zh: 由于这场婚外情，科林·豪尔被迫辞去了所有教会职务，而黑兹尔·布坎南则被禁止再教主日学。

sentences.en: Both were barred from taking communion and, for a time, weren't allowed to attend the same services.
sentences.zh: 两人都被禁止领圣餐，并且有一段时间不允许参加同一场礼拜。

sentences.en: As both couples wished to keep the matter private and were willing to undergo counselling, it was decided that the wider congregation wouldn't be informed of the affair.
sentences.zh: 由于两对夫妇都希望将此事保密，且愿意接受辅导，因此决定不将婚外情告知广大教众。

sentences.en: Still, both Leslie and Colin ended up confiding in close friends about it, and it quickly became a hot topic of gossip.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，莱斯利和科林最终还是向密友吐露了此事，它迅速成为了热门的八卦话题。

sentences.en: During church counselling, Hazel was an open book.
sentences.zh: 在教会辅导期间，黑兹尔知无不言。

sentences.en: She came across as naive and out of her depth when it came to Colin, who answered questions reluctantly and evasively.
sentences.zh: 在面对科林时，她表现得天真且不知所措，而科林回答问题时则很不情愿且含糊其辞。

sentences.en: He was unwilling to take any personal responsibility for the affair, instead claiming that he simply couldn't control himself.
sentences.zh: 他不愿为这场婚外情承担任何个人责任，反而声称自己只是无法控制自己。

sentences.en: To the church elders, Colin's efforts to save his marriage were unconvincing.
sentences.zh: 在教会长老看来，科林挽救婚姻的努力毫无说服力。

sentences.en: Leslie saw things differently.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利却有不同的看法。

sentences.en: She believed Colin's remorse was genuine and trusted him when he assured her that the affair was over.
sentences.zh: 她相信科林的悔意是真诚的，并在他向她保证婚外情已经结束时选择相信他。

sentences.en: Trevor was also willing to put the ordeal behind him and to start anew with Hazel.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗也愿意抛开这段痛苦经历，与黑兹尔重新开始。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《罪案调查》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持《罪案调查》继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: In public, Leslie put on a brave face in the aftermath of her husband's infidelity.
sentences.zh: 在公众面前，莱斯利在丈夫不忠之后强颜欢笑。

sentences.en: But behind closed doors, she relied on antidepressants and alcohol to cope.
sentences.zh: 但在私底下，她只能靠抗抑郁药和酒精来苦苦支撑。

sentences.en: Things deteriorated further when Colin finally admitted that his relationship with Hazel had indeed been sexual.
sentences.zh: 当科林最终承认他和黑兹尔的关系确实发生过性行为时，情况进一步恶化了。

sentences.en: Leslie lunged at him, screaming, swearing and scratching at his face.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利朝他扑了过去，尖叫、咒骂并抓挠他的脸。

sentences.en: It was the first time there had been any violence between them.
sentences.zh: 这是他们之间头一次发生暴力冲突。

sentences.en: After the attack, Leslie retreated to the bathroom, where she overdosed on her medication.
sentences.zh: 袭击过后，莱斯利退到浴室里，在那里服用了过量的药物。

sentences.en: She spent three days in hospital recovering.
sentences.zh: 她在医院里度过了三天的恢复期。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of her suicide attempt, Leslie focused on improving herself in the hope of winning back her husband.
sentences.zh: 在自杀未遂之后，莱斯利专注于完善自己，希望能赢回丈夫的心。

sentences.en: She even altered her appearance to resemble Hazel Buchanan.
sentences.zh: 她甚至改变了自己的外表，弄得跟黑兹尔·布坎南一样。

sentences.en: But those close to her could see that she couldn't shake the overwhelming sadness she carried,
sentences.zh: 但熟悉她的人都能看出，她无法摆脱内心挥之不去的巨大悲伤，

sentences.en: particularly as she came to realise that Colin was merely going through the motions expected of him by the church and had no genuine interest in saving their marriage.
sentences.zh: 尤其是当她渐渐意识到科林只是在走教会期望他走的过场，根本没有真诚的兴趣去挽救他们的婚姻时。

sentences.en: Leslie began meeting privately with Trevor Buchanan, hoping they could support one another through their shared ordeal.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利开始私下与特雷弗·布坎南会面，希望他们能在这场共同的磨难中互相扶持。

sentences.en: More often than not, dwelling on their mutual heartache only made things worse for her.
sentences.zh: 但往往是，沉溺于彼此共同的心碎只会让她的处境雪上加霜。

sentences.en: Unlike the Howells, counselling appeared to have a more positive impact on the Buchanans.
sentences.zh: 与豪尔夫妇不同，辅导对布坎南夫妇似乎产生了更积极的影响。

sentences.en: Their relationship seemed to improve, particularly as Trevor accepted some responsibility for the breakdown of their marriage and his wife's affair.
sentences.zh: 他们的关系似乎有所改善，特别是特雷弗承担了婚姻破裂和妻子出轨的一部分责任。

sentences.en: In time, his demeanour began to return to its usual affable and carefree nature.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，他的神态开始恢复其一贯的和蔼与无忧无虑的本性。

sentences.en: He even agreed to meet with Colin Howell during a church-appointed counselling session and shook his hand as a gesture of reconciliation.
sentences.zh: 他甚至同意在教会指定的辅导期间与科林·豪尔见面，并与他握手以示和解。

sentences.en: But things took a turn after just four months of church counselling.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅经过四个月的教会事情就发生了转变。

sentences.en: When Colin heard that Hazel was doing well and had seemingly moved on with her life, he needed to know whether it was true.
sentences.zh: 当科林听说黑兹尔过得很好、生活似乎已经翻篇时，他需要弄清楚这是不是真的。

sentences.en: If so, he believed it would be the catalyst he needed to finally get over her and recommit to his marriage.
sentences.zh: 如果属实，他相信这将成为他最终放下她并重新承诺回归婚姻所需的催化剂。

sentences.en: Against the church's explicit rules, Colin called Hazel in March 1991 and admitted that things were terrible for him.
sentences.zh: 违反教会的明文规定，科林于1991年3月打电话给黑兹尔，承认自己的生活一团糟。

sentences.en: He said Leslie's depression had reached its lowest point.
sentences.zh: 他说莱斯利的抑郁症已经跌入了谷底。

sentences.en: She was prone to long bouts of crying, struggle to eat, argued with Colin frequently, and sometimes followed him or questioned his friends about his whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 她动不动就痛哭流涕，吃不下饭，经常与科林争吵，有时甚至跟踪他或向他的朋友打听他的行踪。

sentences.en: Despite everything suggesting otherwise, Hazel claimed that life with Trevor was equally unhappy.
sentences.zh: 尽管种种迹象表明并非如此，但黑兹尔声称她与特雷弗在一起的生活同样不幸福。

sentences.en: She confessed that she hadn't moved on from Colin, and the pair resumed their affair.
sentences.zh: 她坦白自己并没有放下科林，于是两人重燃爱火。

sentences.en: Two months later, on Tuesday May 7, 1991, Leslie's father was found dead on the kitchen floor, appearing to have died of natural causes.
sentences.zh: 两个月后的1991年5月7日星期二，莱斯利的父亲被发现死在厨房地板上，死因似乎是自然死亡。

sentences.en: Like the death of her mother, it was a devastating loss.
sentences.zh: 就像母亲的去世一样，这是一场毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: Leslie told a friend that she had lost the only man she ever loved.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利告诉一个朋友，她失去了她这辈子唯一爱过的男人。

sentences.en: She was inconsolable.
sentences.zh: 她悲痛欲绝，无法自拔。

sentences.en: Her vibrant, warm personality was now completely taken over by profound sadness, grief, and anger, and she was still struggling to cope with the demands of being a wife and mother.
sentences.zh: 她曾经充满活力、温暖热情的个性现在完全被深深的悲伤、痛苦和愤怒所吞噬，她仍然在努力应对身为妻子和母亲的各种要求。

sentences.en: She barely slept and was often groggy, forgetful, and incoherent from her medication and alcohol use.
sentences.zh: 她几乎无法入眠，由于药物和酒精的使用，常常昏昏沉沉、健忘且语无伦次。

sentences.en: She was once found barely conscious in a pool of vomit and red wine.
sentences.zh: 有一次，人们发现她奄奄一息地躺在一泊呕吐物和红葡萄酒中。

sentences.en: While Leslie hadn't explicitly expressed suicidal thoughts before her death, she had told a friend of Colin and Hazel,
sentences.zh: 虽然莱斯利在死前并没有明确表达过自杀的想法，但她曾对科林和黑兹尔的一位朋友说过：

sentences.en: Maybe they'd be better off without me.
sentences.zh: 也许没有我，他们会过得更好。

sentences.en: Why not just let them have each other?
sentences.zh: 为什么不干脆让他们拥有彼此呢？

sentences.en: Less than two weeks after her father's death, Leslie Howell was found dead at his Castle Rock home.
sentences.zh: 在她父亲去世不到两周后，莱斯利·豪尔被发现死在他位于城堡岩的家中。

sentences.en: To police, it appeared to be the tragic culmination of the emotional turmoil she had endured in the years preceding her death.
sentences.zh: 在警方看来，这似乎是她在死前几年中所忍受的情感痛苦的悲惨高潮。

sentences.en: Colin Howell spoke openly to investigators about the circumstances he believed had contributed to Leslie's mental decline, including his extramarital affairs.
sentences.zh: 科林·豪尔向调查人员公开谈论了他认为导致莱斯利精神崩溃的情况，包括他的婚外情。

sentences.en: His account was supported by his church pastor, elders, and community, Hazel Buchanan, Leslie's friends, and the letter she had left behind.
sentences.zh: 他的说法得到了他的教会牧师、长老和社区、黑兹尔·布坎南、莱斯利的朋友以及她留下的遗书的支持。

sentences.en: Colin also described how, on the night of her death, Leslie had returned home with a three-litre box of red wine, which she began drinking immediately.
sentences.zh: 科林还描述了在她去世的那天晚上，莱斯利带回了一箱三升装的红酒，并开始豪饮起来。

sentences.en: He said he left the house for around ten minutes, and when he returned at ten p.m., Leslie had just finished speaking to someone on the telephone.
sentences.zh: 他说他离开家大约十分钟，当他在晚上十点回来时，莱斯利刚刚结束与某人的电话交谈。

sentences.en: Colin had his suspicions about who she had been talking to.
sentences.zh: 科林对她一直在跟谁通话心存怀疑。

sentences.en: He was aware that Leslie had recently been meeting privately with Trevor Buchanan, with the two confiding in one another about their troubled marriages.
sentences.zh: 他知道莱斯利最近一直在私下与特雷弗·布坎南会面，两人互相倾诉他们各自陷入困境的婚姻。

sentences.en: As their meetings became more frequent, Colin began telling church elders that he suspected Leslie and Trevor, united by their mutual feelings of rejection and loneliness,
sentences.zh: 随着他们见面次数的增加，科林开始对教会长老说，他怀疑莱斯利和特雷弗因被拒绝和孤独的共同感受而走到了一起

sentences.en: had begun an affair of their own.
sentences.zh: 开始了属于他们自己的婚外情。

sentences.en: The rumours gradually spread through the congregation.
sentences.zh: 谣言在会众中渐渐传开。

sentences.en: Colin recalled several instances where Leslie had suggested that they separate, proposing that doing so would allow her and Trevor to begin a new life.
sentences.zh: 科林回忆起好几次莱斯利提出分居的情形，她建议这样做能让她和特雷ور开启新生活。

sentences.en: She assured Colin that he would be happier as a result, as it would finally allow him and Hazel to be together.
sentences.zh: 她向科林保证，这么做会让他更快乐，因为这最终能让他和黑尔泽在一起。

sentences.en: When Colin accused Leslie of speaking to Trevor on the telephone, she denied it and lashed out at him.
sentences.zh: 当科林指责莱斯利在电话里和特雷ور交谈时，她矢口否认并对大发雷霆。

sentences.en: She lamented that he would never understand the pain he had caused them.
sentences.zh: 她痛心地说，他永远不会理解他给他们带来的痛苦。

sentences.en: Colin then went to bed.
sentences.zh: 随后科林上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: Shortly thereafter, he heard Trevor in the house.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他听到特雷ور在房子里。

sentences.en: When he went to investigate, Trevor confronted him, angrily berating him over Hazel.
sentences.zh: 当他去查看时，特雷ور质问了他，并因黑尔泽的事愤怒地训斥了他。

sentences.en: He stepped towards Colin as if to grab him, but Colin managed to get hold of him first and restrain him.
sentences.zh: 他向科林走去，仿佛要抓住他，但科林设法先一步抓住了他并将其制服。

sentences.en: Trevor offered no resistance, apologised and left.
sentences.zh: 特雷ور没有反抗，道了歉便离开了。

sentences.en: Colin tried to reconcile with Leslie, but she wasn't interested.
sentences.zh: 科林试图与莱斯利重修旧好，但她毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: He returned to bed alone.
sentences.zh: 他独自一人回到了床上。

sentences.en: When he woke again shortly before 8.30am, Leslie was gone.
sentences.zh: 当他在早上八点半前不久再次醒来时，莱斯利已经不见了。

sentences.en: So was their reno.
sentences.zh: 他们的车也一样不在了。

sentences.en: In the kitchen, Colin found the handwritten letter she had left for him.
sentences.zh: 在厨房里，科林找到了她留给他的亲笔信。

sentences.en: He read it several times before the realisation dawned that it might be a suicide note.
sentences.zh: 他读了好几遍，才突然意识到这可能是一封遗书。

sentences.en: Hazel Buchanan told police about her final moments with Trevor.
sentences.zh: 黑尔泽·布坎南向警方讲述了她与特雷ور在一起的最后时光。

sentences.en: She explained that they had cut their day out short because things between them had become increasingly unpleasant
sentences.zh: 她解释说，他们缩短了外出的时间，因为他们之间的关系变得越来越不愉快

sentences.en: ever since Trevor had found out that Hazel and Colin had resumed their affair.
sentences.zh: 自从特雷ور发现黑尔泽和科林恢复了婚外情以来。

sentences.en: That night, they watched television together.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他们一起看电视。

sentences.en: Aside from a few snide and hurtful remarks, they barely spoke.
sentences.zh: 除了几句尖酸刻薄、伤人的话，他们几乎一言不发。

sentences.en: Hazel went to bed a little after 10pm while Trevor stayed up.
sentences.zh: 晚上十点刚过，黑尔泽就上床睡觉了，而特雷ور则熬夜未睡。

sentences.en: Hazel said she was woken by voices at around 3 or 4am.
sentences.zh: 黑尔泽说她在凌晨三四点左右被说话声吵醒。

sentences.en: Recognising them as Trevor and Leslie Howe, Hazel chose to remain in bed, not wanting a confrontation with Leslie.
sentences.zh: 认出是特雷ور和莱斯利·豪尔后，黑尔泽选择留在床上，不想与莱斯利发生冲突。

sentences.en: She woke again at 5am and noticed that Trevor wasn't beside her.
sentences.zh: 她在早上五点再次醒来，发现特雷ور不在身边。

sentences.en: Several hours later, she was informed that his body had been found with Leslie's in Castle Rock.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，她接到通知，说他的尸体和莱斯利的尸体在卡城堡岩被找到了。

sentences.en: Hazel wept at the news.
sentences.zh: 黑尔泽听到这个消息失声痛哭。

sentences.en: Acknowledging her role in the pain endured by Leslie and Trevor, she apologised to Trevor's family and blamed herself for what had happened.
sentences.zh: 她承认自己在莱斯利和特雷ور所承受的痛苦中扮演的角色，向特雷ور的家人道歉，并将发生的一切归咎于自己。

sentences.en: But there was one person who appeared remarkably unaffected by the tragedy.
sentences.zh: 但有一个人似乎对这场悲剧表现得异常平静。

sentences.en: Colin Howell remained composed and showed little emotion when his pastor broke the news that his wife and her lover had been found dead.
sentences.zh: 当牧师宣布他的妻子和她的情人被发现身亡时，科林·豪尔表现得很镇定，几乎没有流露出什么情绪。

sentences.en: To those around him, Colin's reaction was so cold that they could only assume he was keeping his true feelings bottled up for the sake of his children.
sentences.zh: 在身边的人看来，科林的反应是如此冷漠，以至于他们只能认为他是为了孩子才把真实的情感深埋在心底。

sentences.en: Unable to comprehend the finality of death, they asked him when their mother would be coming home.
sentences.zh: 由于无法理解死亡的终结性，他们问他母亲什么时候回家。

sentences.en: Colin's reply was blunt.
sentences.zh: 科林的回答很生硬。

sentences.en: An inquest into the deaths of Leslie Howell and Trevor Buchanan was held a few days before the first anniversary of the incident.
sentences.zh: 在事件发生一周年前夕，举行了关于莱斯利·豪尔和特雷ور·布坎南死因的研讯。

sentences.en: Colin Howell was present in court.
sentences.zh: 科林·豪尔出席了法庭。

sentences.en: He sat alone and still appeared remarkably composed given the circumstance.
sentences.zh: 他独自坐着，鉴于当时的情况，他看起来依然异常镇定。

sentences.en: Colin told the inquest about the strain that had developed and intensified in his marriage following the births of their four children.
sentences.zh: 科林在听证会上讲述了随着四个孩子的出生，他的婚姻中产生并加剧的压力。

sentences.en: He spoke about Leslie's deteriorating mental health, exacerbated by the loss of her beloved parents, her overdose in 1990,
sentences.zh: 他谈到了莱斯利不断恶化的心理健康，这由于她挚爱的父母离世、她在1990年服药过量

sentences.en: and the way she had become increasingly volatile and dependent on pills and alcohol.
sentences.zh: 以及她变得越来越喜怒无常、对药丸和酒精产生依赖的情况而雪上加霜。

sentences.en: He detailed his affair with Hazel Buchanan and how, as a result, Leslie and Trevor had commenced an affair of their own.
sentences.zh: 他详细叙述了自己与黑尔泽·布坎南的婚外情，以及因此莱斯利和特雷ور也开始了自己的婚外情。

sentences.en: Hazel testified at the inquest, as did the church members who had worked to resolve the complex web of infidelity that had plagued the Howell and Buchanan families,
sentences.zh: 黑尔泽在听证会上作证，曾努力化解豪尔和布坎南家族之间那错综复杂的出轨网络教会成员也作了证，

sentences.en: along with the police officers who had investigated the two deaths.
sentences.zh: 调查这两起死亡事件的警官们亦是如此。

sentences.en: After examining all the evidence, the coroner presented their findings.
sentences.zh: 在审查了所有证据后，验尸官公布了他们的调查结果。

sentences.en: They concluded that the deceased had been emotionally upset by difficulties that had arisen in their marriage.
sentences.zh: 他们的结论是，死者因婚姻中出现的困难而在情感上受到了困扰。

sentences.en: The deaths of Leslie's parents and her previous suicide attempts were also noted in her report.
sentences.zh: 她的报告中也记录了莱斯利父母的去世以及她先前的自杀未遂。

sentences.en: The inquest concluded that these difficulties had been the motivating factors behind both Leslie and Trevor taking their own lives.
sentences.zh: 听证会得出结论，这些困难是莱斯利和特雷ور两人寻短见的动因。

sentences.en: Officially, the incident was dismissed as a terrible tragedy.
sentences.zh: 官方将这起事件轻描淡写地归结为一场可怕的悲剧。

sentences.en: For the most part, everyone accepted the findings.
sentences.zh: 大多数人都接受了这一调查结果。

sentences.en: The Coleraine Baptist Church was just keen to move past the scandal.
sentences.zh: 科雷莱因浸信会只想让大家抛开这桩丑闻。

sentences.en: Yet, there were some who harboured serious misgivings.
sentences.zh: 然而，仍有一些人怀有严重的疑虑。

sentences.en: Trevor's family and friends continued to struggle with the idea that he had wanted to take his own life,
sentences.zh: 特雷ور的家人和朋友始终无法接受他曾想过结束自己生命的说法，

sentences.en: while others were beginning to question the official version of events altogether.
sentences.zh: 而其他人则开始对官方的事件版本产生彻底的质疑。

sentences.en: David Green was the off-duty police detective who accompanied churchholder Jim Flanagan to the Castle Rock house when Leslie and Trevor's bodies were discovered.
sentences.zh: 大卫·格林是一名休班警探，当莱斯利和特雷ور的遗体被发现时，他陪同教会长老吉姆·弗拉纳根去了城堡岩的住所。

sentences.en: While Jim was the one who found them in the garage, David checked both for signs of life and immediately got the impression that they had been dead for some time.
sentences.zh: 虽然是吉姆在车库里找到了他们，但大卫检查了两人的生命体征，并立即产生了一种他们已经死去一段时间的印象。

sentences.en: David later heard Colin Howell's account of what had happened in the house hours before the tragedy, including the timings of when Leslie and Trevor were last seen alive,
sentences.zh: 大卫后来听取了科林·豪尔关于悲剧发生前几小时屋内情况的陈述，包括莱斯利和特雷ور生前最后一次被看到的时间，

sentences.en: and wasn't entirely convinced.
sentences.zh: 并且并没有完全信服。

sentences.en: This led him to begin taking notes of the inconsistencies he had noticed.
sentences.zh: 这促使他开始记录下自己注意到的矛盾之处。

sentences.en: Among his suspicions was the possibility that the suicide note Leslie had left for Colin hadn't been written that night at all.
sentences.zh: 他的怀疑之一是，莱斯利留给科林的遗书根本就不是当晚写的。

sentences.en: David wondered whether she might have authored it on an earlier occasion, perhaps around the time of her overdose in 1990,
sentences.zh: 大卫想知道她是不是在更早的时候写的，也许是在1990年她服药过量的那段时间左右，

sentences.en: and that it had merely happened to fit the circumstances surrounding her death.
sentences.zh: 而这恰好符合她死时的环境。

sentences.en: The paper had been scrunched up, suggesting that Leslie had tried to discard it and never intended for anyone else to see it.
sentences.zh: 这张纸被揉成了一团，这表明莱斯利曾试图把它扔掉，从没打算让任何人看到。

sentences.en: David Green wondered if Colin had come across it and kept it to use later as part of a deadly scheme.
sentences.zh: 大卫·格林想知道科林是否偶然发现了它，并把它留下来以后作为致命计划的一部分。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Leslie had told a friend that Colin was in charge of her medication and would give it to her to help her sleep.
sentences.zh: 此外，莱斯利曾告诉过一个朋友，科林负责她的药物，会把药给她以帮她入睡。

sentences.en: David Green considered whether Colin might have been excessively drugging his wife in the lead up to her death, creating the impression that her health was deteriorating
sentences.zh: 大卫·格林在思考科林是否在妻子死前过量给她用药，从而给人一种她的健康状况正在恶化、

sentences.en: and she was losing the will to live.
sentences.zh: 她正在失去求生欲的印象。

sentences.en: This was despite the fact that, after her overdose in 1990,
sentences.zh: 尽管事实上，在1990年她服药过量之后，

sentences.en: Leslie promised a friend that she would never attempt to take her own life again, saying,
sentences.zh: 莱斯利曾向一位朋友保证她绝不会再试图寻短见，并说道：

sentences.en: I can't leave the kids.
sentences.zh: 我不能离开孩子们。

sentences.en: David Green's suspicions extended even further.
sentences.zh: 大卫·格林的怀疑还不止于此。

sentences.en: Leslie's father, Harry, had been found dead 11 days before Leslie died.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利的父亲哈里在莱斯利死前11天被发现死亡。

sentences.en: Harry was living with the Howells at the time and had been taking several prescription medications, including sedatives.
sentences.zh: 哈里当时和豪尔一家住在一起，一直在服用几种处方药，包括镇静剂。

sentences.en: Given his age and the absence of any obvious signs of foul play, it was easy for others to assume that he had simply died of natural causes.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他的年龄且没有任何明显的他杀迹象，其他人很容易认为他只是自然死亡。

sentences.en: As such, no post-mortem examination had been carried out.
sentences.zh: 因此，并没有进行尸检。

sentences.en: David, however, wondered whether Colin had gone so far as to kill Harry by overdosing him with medication.
sentences.zh: 然而，大卫怀疑科林是否做得更绝，通过给哈里过量服药将其杀害。

sentences.en: Having succeeded without arousing suspicion, he had then used the same method on his wife.
sentences.zh: 在没有引起怀疑的情况下成功得手后，他又对妻子如法炮制。

sentences.en: There was a motive.
sentences.zh: 这里存在一个动机。

sentences.en: Following her father's death, Leslie received an inheritance of a little over £200,000.
sentences.zh: 在她父亲去世后，莱斯利获得了略多于20万英镑的遗产。

sentences.en: She had told friends that the money was enough to make her financially independent and she had expressed her intention to not let Colin get any of it.
sentences.zh: 她曾告诉朋友，这笔钱足以让她实现经济独立，并表达了她绝不让科林分走一分钱的意愿。

sentences.en: But after her own death, the inheritance passed into Colin's hands.
sentences.zh: 但死后，这笔遗产落入了科林手中。

sentences.en: He also received a 50-50 share of the money in Harry's personal bank account and half the proceeds of the sale from his house.
sentences.zh: 他还获得了哈里个人银行账户中一半的存款，以及他房屋出售所得的一半收益。

sentences.en: As for Trevor Buchanan, David Green was aware that he had recently booked a family holiday.
sentences.zh: 至于特雷ور·布坎南，大卫·格林知道他最近刚预订了一场家庭度假。

sentences.en: He wondered why someone preparing to take their own life would still be making plans for the future.
sentences.zh: 他纳闷，一个准备结束自己生命的人为什么还会为未来做计划。

sentences.en: Trevor had also invited a colleague to join him at church on the day he was found dead, indicating that he intended to be there.
sentences.zh: 特雷ور还邀请了一位同事在他被发现死亡的那天去教堂，这表明他打算去那里。

sentences.en: To David, there was no evidence to suggest that Trevor had been suicidal at any point, particularly given that he had responded well to marriage counselling
sentences.zh: 在大卫看来，没有任何证据表明特雷ور在任何时候有自杀倾向，特别是考虑到他对婚姻咨询反应良好，

sentences.en: and appeared noticeably happier in the weeks before his death.
sentences.zh: 并且在死前的几周里显得明显更快乐。

sentences.en: After Hazel's infidelity had been exposed, Trevor had even reassured his brother that there was no need to fear he would take his own life over it.
sentences.zh: 在黑尔泽的不忠行为曝光后，特雷ور甚至向他的兄弟保证，不用担心他会为此寻短见。

sentences.en: David Green's suspicions that there was more to the tragedy were strong, yet he didn't get the impression that anyone else was seriously questioning
sentences.zh: 大卫·格林对这场悲剧另有隐情的怀疑很强烈，但他并没有觉得有其他人真正在质疑

sentences.en: the circumstances surrounding Leslie and Trevor's deaths.
sentences.zh: 围绕莱斯利和特雷ور死因的环境。

sentences.en: He said he spoke about his concerns to Coleraine Baptist Church pastor John Hansford, who had been guiding the Howell and Buchanan families through their marital difficulties.
sentences.zh: 他说他曾向科雷莱因浸信会牧师约翰·汉斯福德谈及自己的担忧，这位牧师一直引导豪尔和布坎南家族度过婚姻危机。

sentences.en: David also claimed that he raised his concerns with the case investigators on several occasions, something the investigators themselves denied.
sentences.zh: 大卫还声称他曾多次向案件调查人员提出他的担忧，而调查人员对此予以否认。

sentences.en: They maintained that they had kept an open mind throughout their investigation and had found no reason to suspect that a crime had taken place.
sentences.zh: 他们坚称在整个调查过程中保持着开放的态度，并且没有发现任何理由怀疑发生了犯罪。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, David held onto an article he had read in a police magazine titled,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，大卫保留了一篇他在一本警务杂志上读到的文章，题为：

sentences.en: Making Murder Look Like Suicide.
sentences.zh: 让谋杀看起来像自杀。

sentences.en: The case investigators maintained that if David had raised such concerns with them, they would have absolutely investigated the matter further.
sentences.zh: 案件调查人员坚称，如果大卫向他们提出过这种担忧，他们绝对会对此事进行进一步调查。

sentences.en: After a while, David decided he needed to take a step back.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，大卫觉得他需要退一步。

sentences.en: He wasn't a part of the investigation team and was stationed in a different division.
sentences.zh: 他不是调查组的成员，而且被派驻在不同的部门。

sentences.en: He feared his questioning might be perceived as insensitive and he didn't want to stand on anyone's toes or risk making a nuisance of himself.
sentences.zh: 他担心自己的质问会被认为是不近人情，他不想踩别人的脚趾，也不想冒惹人嫌的风险。

sentences.en: He trusted that the investigation had been rigorous and exhaustive and pushed his concerns to the back of his mind.
sentences.zh: 他相信调查是严谨而详尽的，并将自己的担忧抛诸脑后。

sentences.en: In the years after his wife's death,
sentences.zh: 在妻子去世后的几年里，

sentences.en: Colin Howell would tell their children that it had looked like a suicide, but no one was really ever sure.
sentences.zh: 科林·豪尔会告诉他们的孩子，这看起来像是一场自杀，但谁也说不准。

sentences.en: They witnessed him cry over Leslie only a handful of times.
sentences.zh: 他们见他为莱斯利哭泣的次数屈指可数。

sentences.en: He soon stopped visiting her grave and discouraged them from mentioning her at all.
sentences.zh: 他很快就不再去她的坟墓，并阻止他们提起她。

sentences.en: He appeared to move on remarkably quickly, adjusting to life as a single father with relative ease.
sentences.zh: 他似乎以惊人的速度走出了阴影，相对轻松地适应了单亲父亲的生活。

sentences.en: He regained his financial footing through the life insurance payouts from both Leslie and her father.
sentences.zh: 通过莱斯利和她父亲的人寿保险赔付，他重新恢复了财务基础。

sentences.en: To his children, it felt as though their mother never existed.
sentences.zh: 在孩子们看来，仿佛他们的母亲从未存在过一般。

sentences.en: In contrast, Hazel Buchanan made a conscious effort to keep Trevor's memory alive for their two children.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，黑尔泽·布坎南有意识地努力让特雷ور的记忆在两个孩子心中长存。

sentences.en: She kept photographs of him on display, told them stories about him and remained in close contact with his extended family.
sentences.zh: 她摆放着他的照片，向孩子们讲他的故事，并与他的大家庭保持着密切联系。

sentences.en: She did her best to help her children come to terms with what had happened, going so far as to admit that she had been involved in an extramarital affair with Colin Howell.
sentences.zh: 她尽最大努力帮助孩子们接受发生的一切，甚至承认自己曾与科林·豪尔有过婚外情。

sentences.en: While she avoided using the word suicide, her children came to understand that Trevor had taken his own life as a result of her infidelity.
sentences.zh: 虽然她避免使用“自杀”这个词，但孩子们渐渐明白，特雷ور是因为她的不忠而结束了自己的生命。

sentences.en: Still, they didn't hold it against her.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，他们并没有因此怨恨她。

sentences.en: Hazel explained that although they had their problems, she had still loved Trevor.
sentences.zh: 黑尔泽解释说，尽管他们有问题，但她仍然爱着特雷ور。

sentences.en: His children had also loved him deeply.
sentences.zh: 他的孩子们也深爱着他。

sentences.en: Although their memories of him were limited, they were defined by warmth and pride.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们对他的记忆有限，但那些记忆充满了温暖与骄傲。

sentences.en: Hazel never sought to tarnish her children's view of their father.
sentences.zh: 黑尔泽从未试图抹黑孩子们对父亲的看法。

sentences.en: She told them that he was watching over them in heaven and took them to place fresh flowers on his grave every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他们他在天堂看着他们，并带他们每个星期天去他的坟前献上鲜花。

sentences.en: Hazel considered moving away from Coleraine, especially since members of the community had ostracised her.
sentences.zh: 黑尔泽曾考虑离开科雷莱因，特别是社区成员排挤她之后。

sentences.en: But for the time being, she chose to attend a different church.
sentences.zh: 但目前，她选择去另一家教堂。

sentences.en: Although she rarely spoke about what had happened or sought sympathy over it, it was clear to those around her that Hazel was determined to rebuild her life.
sentences.zh: 尽管她很少谈论发生的事情或博取同情，但周围的人都清楚，黑尔泽决心重建生活。

sentences.en: Many were willing to give her the space to do so.
sentences.zh: 许多人愿意给她空间去这样做。

sentences.en: Except Colin Howell.
sentences.zh: 科林·豪尔除外。

sentences.en: He remained a consistent presence in Hazel's life over the next few years, despite his pastor urging him to break contact with her altogether.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，他一直频繁出现在黑尔泽的生活中，尽管他的牧师敦促他彻底断绝与她的联系。

sentences.en: Instead, Colin asked Hazel to marry him.
sentences.zh: 相反，科林向黑尔泽求婚了。

sentences.en: Eventually, Hazel had enough.
sentences.zh: 最终，黑尔泽受够了。

sentences.en: She admitted that she didn't want to be his wife, telling Colin that their relationship was a disaster and insisting that they would never work.
sentences.zh: 她承认自己不想做他的妻子，告诉科林他们的关系是一场灾难，并坚称他们永远不会有好结果。

sentences.en: She also didn't want the added responsibility of raising his four children or to give up the police pension she received following Trevor's death.
sentences.zh: 她也不想承担抚养他四个孩子的额外责任，或者放弃她在特雷ور死后获得的警察抚恤金。

sentences.en: Colin refused to accept that their relationship was coming to an end, even after Hazel tried to break it off several times.
sentences.zh: 科林拒绝接受他们的关系走向终点，即便在黑尔泽多次试图分手后也是如此。

sentences.en: Colin always managed to convince her to stay with him, often by buying her things.
sentences.zh: 科林总能设法说服她留在自己身边，通常是通过给她买东西。

sentences.en: Hazel later described Colin as
sentences.zh: 黑尔泽后来将科林描述为

sentences.en: Eventually, Colin discovered that Hazel was seeing someone else.
sentences.zh: 最终，科林发现黑尔泽在和别人交往。

sentences.en: A prolonged period of intense jealousy followed, wherein Colin stalked Hazel as she met with her new partner.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是一段漫长而强烈的嫉妒期，科林跟踪和新伴侣约会的黑尔泽。

sentences.en: She later cheated on him with a man she met at a gym.
sentences.zh: 她后来在健身房认识的一个男人背叛了他。

sentences.en: The same stories about Hazel Buchanan that had circulated during her first marriage continued to follow her, that she was incredibly materialistic, demanding and controlling.
sentences.zh: 那些在黑尔泽·布坎南第一次婚姻期间流传的关于她的传言依然挥之不去，说她极度物质、苛求且控制欲强。

sentences.en: Yet, Colin Howell still wanted to be with her.
sentences.zh: 然而，科林·豪尔仍然想和她在一起。

sentences.en: In time, his increasingly obsessive behaviour began to frighten Hazel.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，他日益强烈的执迷行为开始吓到黑尔泽。

sentences.en: She believed he was completely unwilling to let her go.
sentences.zh: 她认为他完全不愿放过她。

sentences.en: But Colin perceived the situation differently.
sentences.zh: 但科林的看法则不同。

sentences.en: He felt Hazel was the one holding on.
sentences.zh: 他觉得是黑尔泽在纠缠不放。

sentences.en: In his words,
sentences.zh: 用他的话说：

sentences.en: She wanted it to end, but She couldn't let it end.
sentences.zh: 她想结束这一切，但她无法让它结束。

sentences.en: Five years after Leslie and Trevor's deaths,
sentences.zh: 在莱斯利和特雷ور死后五年，

sentences.en: Colin Howell finally accepted that his relationship with Hazel Buchanan was well and truly over, and that it was time to move on.
sentences.zh: 科林·豪尔终于接受了他与黑尔泽·布坎南的关系已经彻底结束，是时候往前看了。

sentences.en: In December 1996, he met 30-year-old Kyle Jorgensen at a Christian singles night.
sentences.zh: 1996年12月，他在一个基督教单身之夜遇到了30岁的凯尔·约根森。

sentences.en: A whirlwind romance followed, and the pair married less than six months later.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是一段闪恋，两人在不到六个月后就结婚了。

sentences.en: Just two weeks after their wedding,
sentences.zh: 就在他们婚礼后两周，

sentences.en: Kyle discovered that she was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 凯尔发现自己怀孕了。

sentences.en: Kyle and Colin would go on to have five children together.
sentences.zh: 凯尔和科林后来一起有了五个孩子。

sentences.en: With Kyle's two children from a previous marriage, and the four Colin had with Leslie, they eventually had 11 children between them.
sentences.zh: 加上凯尔与前一段婚姻的两个孩子，以及科林和莱斯利生的四个孩子，他们最终一共抚养了11个孩子。

sentences.en: Kyle soon found herself in a situation not unlike Leslie's.
sentences.zh: 凯尔很快发现自己陷入了一种与莱斯利相差无几的境地。

sentences.en: She put her own ambitions aside to devote herself full-time to motherhood, navigating the difficulties and stresses that came with it, while Colin spent much of his time at work.
sentences.zh: 她抛下自己的雄心壮志，全身心投入到母亲的角色中，应对随之而来的困难与压力，而科林则把大部分时间花在工作上。

sentences.en: When they met,
sentences.zh: 当他们相遇时，

sentences.en: Colin had told Kyle about what happened to his first wife, Leslie.
sentences.zh: 科林曾向凯尔讲述过他的第一任妻子莱斯利遭遇的不幸。

sentences.en: He described her mental health struggles and said that she had taken her own life, taking full responsibility for her death
sentences.zh: 他描述了她与心理健康问题的斗争，并称她选择结束自己的生命，为她的死承担了全部责任，

sentences.en: by admitting that his infidelity had played a part in it.
sentences.zh: 并承认自己的出轨行为在其中推波助澜。

sentences.en: He also told Kyle that Trevor Buchanan, the husband of the woman with whom he had had an affair, had also taken his own life.
sentences.zh: 他还告诉凯尔，特雷弗·布坎南——也就是他曾与之有染的那个女人的丈夫，也已经自杀身亡。

sentences.en: He didn't say much else.
sentences.zh: 他没有多说什么别的。

sentences.en: Around 18 months into their marriage,
sentences.zh: 在他们结婚约18个月后，

sentences.en: Colin was sitting on the couch with Kyle when she noticed that he appeared unusually anxious.
sentences.zh: 有一天科林正和凯尔坐在沙发上，凯尔注意到他显得异常焦虑。

sentences.en: Suddenly, he blurted out, it's my fault, it's all my responsibility.
sentences.zh: 突然，他脱口而出，这是我的错，这全都是我的责任。

sentences.en: I did it.
sentences.zh: 是我干的。

sentences.en: I killed Leslie.
sentences.zh: 我害死了莱斯利。

sentences.en: He also confessed to killing Trevor.
sentences.zh: 他还供认了杀害特雷弗的罪行。

sentences.en: Although he didn't go into detail, he mentioned a garden hose.
sentences.zh: 虽然他没有细说，但提到了花园水管。

sentences.en: Kyle sat in shock before saying that she wanted to call the police.
sentences.zh: 凯尔震惊地坐在那里，随后说她想报警。

sentences.en: Colin pleaded with her not to.
sentences.zh: 科林苦苦哀求她不要这样做。

sentences.en: He urged her to think about their children and their future.
sentences.zh: 他催促她想想他们的孩子和未来。

sentences.en: He implied that he intended to come forward with the truth eventually, but needed time to make sure everything was in place.
sentences.zh: 他暗示自己最终打算说出真相，但需要时间来确保一切万无一失。

sentences.en: He told her,
sentences.zh: 他对她说：

sentences.en: It's been seven years.
sentences.zh: 已经过去七年了。

sentences.en: Surely you can wait one more day.
sentences.zh: 你当然可以再多等一天。

sentences.en: Kyle was emotionally overwhelmed and uncertain, finding the entire situation confusing and disorientating.
sentences.zh: 凯尔情绪崩溃，感到十分迷茫，整个局面令她感到困惑和不知所措。

sentences.en: She barely recognised the man she had married and felt trapped by Colin, fearing for her own safety and that of their children.
sentences.zh: 她几乎认不出自己嫁的这个男人，并感到被科林困住，为她自己和孩子们的安全感到恐惧。

sentences.en: Colin spent the night calming her nerves while promising that once he had secured their children's future, he would surrender himself to the authorities.
sentences.zh: 科林花了一晚上的时间抚平她的情绪，并承诺一旦他为孩子们安排好了未来，就会向当局自首。

sentences.en: Not long afterwards, he arranged for his parents to visit, intending to tell them what he had done before turning himself over to police.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他安排父母来访，打算在向警方自首前告诉他们自己所做的事。

sentences.en: But Colin's father was forced to cancel the meeting last minute.
sentences.zh: 但科林的父亲在最后一刻被迫取消了会面。

sentences.en: That weekend, Colin attended church.
sentences.zh: 那个周末，科林去做了礼拜。

sentences.en: A woman there happened to say to him,
sentences.zh: 教堂里的一个女人碰巧对他说：

sentences.en: All your sins are forgiven and forgotten by God.
sentences.zh: 上帝已经原谅并遗忘了你所有的罪孽。

sentences.en: Colin took the remark as a sign and decided to completely abandon his intentions of ever coming clean.
sentences.zh: 科林将这句话视作一个预兆，并决定彻底放弃坦白一切的想法。

sentences.en: Kyle didn't press the matter.
sentences.zh: 凯尔没有再追问此事。

sentences.en: As time wore on, she gradually settled back into her role as Colin Howell's wife.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，她渐渐回到了科林·豪尔妻子的角色中。

sentences.en: She convinced herself that his confession had been a broader expression of personal guilt over his infidelity and the suffering it had caused,
sentences.zh: 她连哄带骗地说服自己，他当年的供认只是因出轨及其带来的痛苦而产生的一种广泛的内疚感，

sentences.en: rather than an admission that he had actually murdered anyone.
sentences.zh: 而不是承认自己真的谋杀过任何人。

sentences.en: The fact that everyone who knew Colin insisted that he was a good, God-fearing man and a devoted father only reinforced her belief that he was incapable of killing anyone.
sentences.zh: 认识科林的所有人都坚称他是一个善良、敬畏上帝的好父亲，这一事实更加坚定了她认为他不可能杀害任何人的信念。

sentences.en: Colin Howell's fortunes changed dramatically once he decided not to confess what he knew about Leslie and Trevor's deaths.
sentences.zh: 自从科林决定隐瞒他所知道的关于莱斯利和特雷弗之死的秘密后，他的命运发生了戏剧性的转变。

sentences.en: His career thrived, bringing him considerable wealth, exotic holidays, property investments, lavish overseas trips to dental conferences,
sentences.zh: 他的事业蒸蒸日上，为他带来了可观的财富、异国度假、房产投资、前往牙科会议的奢华海外旅行，

sentences.en: and a growing network of high-profile connections.
sentences.zh: 以及日益庞大的高端人脉网络。

sentences.en: Then, in April 2007, almost 16 years after the deaths of Leslie Howell and Trevor Buchanan, his fortunes changed once again.
sentences.zh: 接着，在2007年4月，即莱斯利·豪尔和特雷弗·布坎南去世近16年后，他的命运再次发生了改变。

sentences.en: Matthew Howell was Colin and Leslie's firstborn child.
sentences.zh: 马修·豪尔是科林和莱斯利的第一个孩子。

sentences.en: Throughout Matthew's childhood, his father placed considerable pressure on him to follow in his footsteps and pursue a career in dentistry.
sentences.zh: 在马修的成长过程中，他的父亲对施加了巨大压力，要他子承父业从事牙医职业。

sentences.en: Matthew, who was meek and agreeable, struggled to go against his father's wishes, even though his real interests lay in travel and languages.
sentences.zh: 马修生性温和顺从，尽管他真正的兴趣在于旅游和语言，却很难违背父亲的意愿。

sentences.en: By the age of 22,
sentences.zh: 到22岁时，

sentences.en: Matthew had already travelled throughout North, Central, and South America.
sentences.zh: 马修已经游遍了北美、中美和南美。

sentences.en: In April 2007, he was living in Russia as part of an overseas semester of his university course, with plans to visit China next.
sentences.zh: 2007年4月，作为大学海外学期项目的一部分，他正住在俄罗斯，并计划接下来去中国访问。

sentences.en: But on Monday, April 30,
sentences.zh: 但在4月30日星期一，

sentences.en: Matthew accidentally slipped down a stairwell from the fourth floor of the building where he lived.
sentences.zh: 马修不小心从他所住建筑的四楼楼梯间滑了下去。

sentences.en: He struck a handrail at the bottom and died.
sentences.zh: 他在底部撞到了扶手，不幸身亡。

sentences.en: To others,
sentences.zh: 在别人看来，

sentences.en: Colin appeared to cope remarkably well after Matthew's sudden death, relying on his faith to accept the tragedy as God's will and telling those around him
sentences.zh: 在马修突然离世后，科林表现出奇地坚强，他依靠信仰来接受这场悲剧是上帝的旨意，并对周围的人说

sentences.en: that his son was in a better place.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子去了更好的地方。

sentences.en: Privately,
sentences.zh: 私底下，

sentences.en: Colin interpreted Matthew's death as God's way of punishing him.
sentences.zh: 科林将马修的死解读为上帝惩罚他的方式。

sentences.en: The following year,
sentences.zh: 第二年，

sentences.en: Colin heard from a friend about a potentially lucrative venture in the Philippines.
sentences.zh: 科林从一个朋友那里听说菲律宾有一个潜在的暴利投资项目。

sentences.en: According to the friend, they knew an American missionary involved in recovering long-lost gold that had allegedly been buried in underground bunkers by the Japanese
sentences.zh: 据这位朋友所说，他们认识一个美国传教士，此人参与寻找据称在二战期间被日本人埋在地下掩体中的失落已久的黄金。

sentences.en: during World War II.
sentences.zh: 二战期间。

sentences.en: Colin was led to believe that if he invested in their recovery efforts, he stood to receive
sentences.zh: 科林听信了这样一种说法：如果他投资他们的搜寻工作，他将有望获得

sentences.en: 20 million pounds worth of gold.
sentences.zh: 价值2000万英镑的黄金。

sentences.en: Convinced that the scheme was legitimate, he sold his business shares, invested all his savings, and attempted to persuade several friends to invest as well.
sentences.zh: 深信这个计划合法可靠的他卖掉了商业股份，投资了自己所有的积蓄，并试图劝说几位朋友也进行投资。

sentences.en: Eventually,
sentences.zh: 最终，

sentences.en: Colin was sent a couple of brass ammunition boxes containing silver coins worth around 30 pounds.
sentences.zh: 科林收到了一对黄铜弹药箱，里面装着价值约30英镑的银币。

sentences.en: In total, he had invested
sentences.zh: 总共算下来，他在这场欺诈性的暴富骗局中投入了

sentences.en: 350,000 pounds of his own money in the fraudulent get-rich-quick scam.
sentences.zh: 350,000英镑的个人积蓄。

sentences.en: He also owed upwards of a further
sentences.zh: 他还欠下了进一步高达

sentences.en: 250,000 pounds in taxes.
With that,
sentences.zh: 就这样，

sentences.en: Colin had fallen back into debt.
sentences.zh: 科林再次陷入了债务危机。

sentences.en: Like his son's untimely death,
sentences.zh: 就像儿子英年早逝一样，

sentences.en: Colin interpreted his sudden financial downfall as another form of divine punishment.
sentences.zh: 科林将自己突如其来的财务崩溃解读为另一种形式的天谴。

sentences.en: Although Colin didn't openly discuss his problems, those around him could see that he was deeply tormented.
sentences.zh: 尽管科林没有公开谈论自己的问题，但周围的人都能看出他饱受折磨。

sentences.en: No longer the driven and dynamic man he had once been, he became withdrawn, unfocused, and depressed.
sentences.zh: 他不再是曾经那个意气风发、充满干劲的男人，变得孤僻、注意力不集中且情绪低落。

sentences.en: He lost weight and appeared increasingly disorientated, struggling to think rationally and losing touch with reality.
sentences.zh: 他日渐消瘦，显得越发迷茫，难以理性思考并逐渐脱离现实。

sentences.en: Eventually, he was no longer capable of treating patients.
sentences.zh: 最终，他再也无力为病人治病。

sentences.en: Those closest to him grew concerned, wondering whether he might follow in his first wife's footsteps and take his own life.
sentences.zh: 与他最亲近的人开始感到担忧，怀疑他是否会步第一任妻子的后尘选择自杀。

sentences.en: Even his current wife,
sentences.zh: 就连他的现任妻子

sentences.en: Kyle, recognised that something was seriously wrong.
sentences.zh: 凯尔也意识到情况非常不对劲。

sentences.en: Fearing what Colin might do, she stayed out of the house with their children whenever she could.
sentences.zh: 由于害怕科林做出什么事，她只要一有机会就会带着孩子们躲在外面。

sentences.en: Colin saw himself as being on the brink of spiritual collapse.
sentences.zh: 科林觉得自己正处于精神崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: He had finally come to the realisation that he had been a hypocrite throughout his life, claiming to strictly follow God's teachings while repeatedly flouting them.
sentences.zh: 他终于意识到自己一生都在伪善，口口声声说严格遵循上帝的教导，却又屡屡违背。

sentences.zh: 在星期四的早晨，

2009, he sat with his wife and admitted that he felt eternally damned.
sentences.zh: 他与妻子坐在一起，坦白说自己感到了永世不得超生。

sentences.en: Although he was reluctant to accept that it was finally time to come forward with the truth of his indiscretions,
sentences.zh: 尽管他不愿接受终于到了说出自己荒唐行为真相的时候，

sentences.en: Kyle encouraged him to do so.
sentences.zh: 但在凯尔的鼓励下，他还是决定这么做。

sentences.en: She told him that the difficulties he had faced recently were God's way of giving him another chance to repent.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，他最近面临的困境是上帝给他另一次忏悔机会的方式。

sentences.en: Colin hugged his children before meeting with the elders of his church.
sentences.zh: 科林拥抱了孩子们，然后去见了教堂的长老们。

sentences.en: They were already aware that he had been experiencing some kind of crisis, having recently discussed matters of salvation, forgiveness and repentance with them.
sentences.zh: 他们此前已经讨论过救赎、宽恕和忏悔的事宜，因此早已知道他一直在经历某种危机。

sentences.en: But what he told them that day left them stunned.

sentences.zh: 他透露，自己曾带黑兹尔·布坎南离开镇上去做流产手术，因为他们不确定孩子的父亲究竟是谁。

sentences.en: They feared that if it was Colin's, the child might bear his features and expose their infidelity.
sentences.zh: 他们担心如果孩子是科林的，长相可能会带有他的特征从而暴露他们的私情。

sentences.zh: 但真正让长老们感到极其不安的，

sentences.zh: 他承认自己在牙科诊所里对处于镇静状态下的女性患者实施了性侵。

sentences.en: Following this revelation,
sentences.zh: 在这番爆料之后，

sentences.en: Colin's composure began to crack.
sentences.zh: 科林的镇定开始崩溃。

sentences.en: Bible verses were quoted at him to encourage him to continue opening up, including one that read,
sentences.zh: 人们向他引述了《圣经》经文以鼓励他继续敞开心扉，其中一句写道：

sentences.en: One shall have to undergo suffering to reach truth.
sentences.zh: 人必经受苦难方能抵达真理。

sentences.en: That is why it is said that truth is eternally victorious.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，人们才说真理永远胜利。

sentences.zh: 他双眼紧盯着面前的桌子，

sentences.zh: 在接下来的一小时里，他透露了被他称为

星期一。

sentences.zh: 莱斯利在参加完父亲的葬礼后哭了一整天。

sentences.en: Colin claimed that at around
sentences.zh: 科林称，那天大约在凌晨

sentences.en: 3am that night, she suddenly sat upright in bed and told him that she would never get over what he and Hazel had done and that Trevor wouldn't either.
sentences.zh: 3点，她突然在床上坐直身子，告诉他她永远无法释怀他和黑兹尔做过的事，特雷弗也一样。

sentences.en: Maybe you and Hazel are meant to be together,
sentences.zh: 也许你和黑兹尔本就该在一起，

sentences.en: Colin claimed she had told him.
sentences.zh: 科林称她当时对他说过这样的话。

sentences.en: He said that she wished she were dead and in heaven.
sentences.zh: 他说她当时只希望自己死去并去往天堂。

sentences.en: The remarks didn't particularly trouble Colin as he had already convinced himself that Leslie would die soon anyway, likely as a result of her alcohol dependence.
sentences.zh: 这些话并没有给科林带来太多困扰，因为他当时已经说服自己，无论如何莱斯利很快就会死，很可能是因为酒精依赖。

sentences.en: He didn't want to separate from her beforehand, partly because of his views on divorce.
sentences.zh: 他在此之前不想和她分开，部分原因是他对离婚的看法。

sentences.en: He also believed
sentences.zh: 他也坚信
